card.name: Start of sensitivity/sensitize words
card.fires_on: The word piece "sens" or "ens" that begins the ending "-itivity" or "-itize", as in hypersensitivity, light sensitivity, or sensitize the myocardium.

modes.label: Hypersensitivity
modes.description: Inside hypersensitivity in warnings and headings, often in capitals.
modes.example: OTHER SERIOUS HYPER<<SENS>>ITIVITY REACTIONS See full prescribing

modes.label: Sensitize the myocardium
modes.description: The word sensitize in statements about anesthetics or drugs acting on the heart.
modes.example: is in patients, especially patients suffering from coronary artery disease, organic heart disease, cerebrovascular disease, hypertension, or patients who are receiving drugs that<< sens>>itize the myocardium [see Adverse

modes.label: Light sensitivity
modes.description: Sens at the start of sensitivity after a body-effect word like Light.
modes.example: 5.9 Light<< Sens>>itivity Patients may experience sensitivity of the eyes

card.writes: It pushes the model to finish the word as sensitivity, sensitive or sensitize, including Chinese 敏感.
card.plain: It marks the start of words like hypersensitivity or sensitize, so the model completes them.
